title.en: MALACAÑANG TRANSFERRING THE PHILIPPINE RECLAMATION AUTHORITY FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS TO THE DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENT AND NATURAL RESOURCES
title.orig: MALACAÑANG TRANSFERRING THE PHILIPPINE RECLAMATION AUTHORITY FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS TO THE DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENT AND NATURAL RESOURCES

text.en:
The Philippine Reclamation Authority is hereby transferred to the
Department of Environment and Natural Resources.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 14M day of MAY
Two Thousand and Nine.
glia to keeps
in the year of Our Lord,
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
POMA Hologrom • 48856
